Package repository.factory

Class RepositoryFactory

java.lang.Object
repository.factory.RepositoryFactory
public class RepositoryFactory extends Object
Creates the repositories of the application (Simple Factory pattern).

This is the only class that knows the concrete repository classes. The kind of persistence (RepositoryType) and its parameters are read from a properties file, so switching between memory, file and database storage only means changing repository.type; services, UI and Main do not change. Both repositories are always created for the same type.

Keys read from the configuration:

  • repository.type = MEMORY | FILE | DATABASE (always required)
  • file.users, file.friendships (required for FILE)
  • db.url, db.user, db.password (required for DATABASE)
